qualifier: contractile force, relaxation and hypertrophic sarcomere growth
name: Cardiac contractile force, relaxation and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: All members regulate heart muscle contraction, rate, relaxation or adaptive cardiomyocyte growth; unlike the confusables it lacks proliferation/regeneration (C1), SR calcium handling (C2) and negative contraction control (C4), while carrying force and relaxation regulation.

name: Golgi-to-endosome trafficking and endosomal membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover vesicle budding, Golgi positioning, plasma membrane/Golgi-to-endosome transport and endosome tubulation; Golgi-to-endosome and early-to-late endosome transport are what all confusables lack, and it lacks their Golgi-organization and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation.

qualifier: UV lesion excision repair and translesion bypass
name: Nucleotide excision repair and translesion DNA polymerase synthesis
rationale: Members are NER (GG/TC), translesion synthesis, polymerase switching/replication synthesis and error-prone somatic hypermutation; NER and UV-damage members separate it from the base-excision confusables and somatic hypermutation/telomere C-strand synthesis from the mismatch-repair confusable.

qualifier: vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic regulation
name: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle cell regulation
rationale: Members regulate VEGF/Tie2-driven endothelial sprouting and lymphangiogenesis together with vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation and phenotypic switching; the smooth muscle arm distinguishes it from C1 and the VEGF/Tie endothelial arm from C2-C4.

core: Cytidine deamination in antiviral defence and antibody diversification
qualifier: B cell development and immunoglobulin diversification
name: Cytidine deaminase antiviral restriction and B cell immunoglobulin diversification
rationale: Members center on APOBEC/AID cytidine deamination (antiviral restriction, editosome, somatic hypermutation) plus B cell lineage and V(D)J recombination; the B cell/immunoglobulin members separate it from the viral confusables C1-C3, and the deaminase antiviral members from the class-switching confusable C4.

qualifier: glial fate specification and CNS/PNS myelin maintenance
name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and myelin maintenance
rationale: All members concern glial (oligodendrocyte, Schwann, astrocyte) fate, proliferation, differentiation or myelination; glial fate specification and both CNS and PNS myelin maintenance separate it from the gliosis- and myelin-formation-oriented confusables.

core: Cofactor metabolism and reactive aldehyde detoxification
name: B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism, methylglyoxal detoxification
rationale: Members split between prosthetic-group metabolism (vitamin B6, molybdenum cofactor, Moco-dependent sulfite oxidation) and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with glycation repair of protein and DNA; B6/Moco members distinguish it from glutathione and ROS confusables and methylglyoxal repair from the serine confusable.

name: Stress- and oncogene-induced senescence with heterochromatin foci
rationale: Members regulate oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, proliferative arrest and senescence-associated heterochromatin; heterochromatin foci and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation, and absence of the secretory phenotype, distinguish it from the SASP-bearing confusables.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT signaling and its negative control, and phosphoinositide/inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis; the inositol polyphosphate synthesis members are what C2-C4 lack, and the PTEN/AKT members separate it from the PAK-2p34 confusable C1.

qualifier: axonal growth control and axon caliber
name: Axon-glia interactions in myelination and axonal growth control
rationale: Members combine CNS/PNS myelination, glial responses and axon caliber with axonal growth stimulation/inhibition signaling; the axonal growth signaling separates it from glial confusable C2, and lack of regeneration/sprouting members from C1, C3 and C4.

name: Pancreatic endocrine lineage development and beta-cell insulin secretion
rationale: Members follow pancreatic progenitor and endocrine/neuroendocrine lineage specification through to beta-cell function; beta-cell identity and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion distinguish it from developmental confusables C1-C3, and the lineage members from the incretin/insulin-processing confusable C4.

name: Regulation of proteasomal degradation and degron-directed turnover
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal (ubiquitin-dependent and -independent) catabolism, N-/C-degron pathways, K48 ubiquitination and protein destabilization; it lacks the misfolded-protein, ERAD, aggrephagy and ribosome quality control members that define the confusables.

name: RNA virus genome replication and host translation hijacking
rationale: Members cover coronavirus, influenza and RSV genome replication, viral mRNA synthesis/capping/translation and suppression of host translation; RNA-virus replication separates it from the retroviral/DNA confusable C2, and lack of entry and protein maturation members from C4.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: All members concern vesicle budding and targeting between ER and Golgi; COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic distinguish it from the COPII confusables C3/C4 and from the tethering confusable C1.

name: Ephrin and L1 axon guidance signaling
rationale: Members are axon guidance and fasciculation signals (ephrin repulsion, DCC attraction, RAC1 activation); L1 signaling and recycling are what C1-C3 lack, and ephrin/DCC members what C4 lacks.

qualifier: non-canonical NIK arm and negative regulation
name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB activation and negative regulation
rationale: Members regulate IKK/NF-kB activation by TNFR1, TLR/IRAK1 and NIK, with deficiencies and negative regulators; the non-canonical arm separates it from C1 and the negative-regulation members from C2/C4.

name: CSF1 signaling in microglial and macrophage activation
rationale: Members concern CSF1 receptor signaling driving microglial/macrophage differentiation, proliferation, activation and migration; microglial members separate it from cytokine confusables C1-C3 and CSF1 signaling from the apoptotic-cell-clearance confusable C4.

core: Rhesus glycoprotein gas and ammonium transport
name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members concern Rh-family membrane proteins, their biosynthesis and disease and their ammonium/CO2 transport; Rh members distinguish it from peptide-transport C1 and the erythrocyte oxygen-exchange confusables.

name: Synaptic adhesion and excitatory/inhibitory postsynaptic receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern trans-synaptic adhesion molecules, pre/postsynaptic assembly and AMPA/NMDA/GABA receptor clustering with transmission effects; receptor clustering (AMPA, GABA) and inhibitory synapse members distinguish it from the synapse-assembly confusables.

qualifier: dorsal-ventral axis and neural plate border
name: Neural plate border and dorsal-ventral axis specification
rationale: Members specify early embryonic axes, the anterior/posterior neural plate, its border and neural crest fate; dorsal-ventral axis and neural crest members distinguish it from the hindbrain/forebrain and neural-fold confusables.

name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis via PUMA and NOXA
rationale: Members link p53 transcription of BH3-only and caspase-activator genes to cytochrome c release; the p53 axis separates it from the BAX/BAK/BIM confusable C1, and the PUMA/NOXA mitochondrial members from the death-receptor confusables.

name: Peptidyl lysine and arginine methylation and hydroxylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation (incl. TP53 methylation); methylation members separate it from the hypusine/diphthamide confusables and hydroxylation members from the histone-methylation and translation confusables.

name: Host-pathogen interaction: bacterial entry and toxin uptake
rationale: Members are a loose infection-related set (bacterial attachment/entry, anthrax and diphtheria toxin uptake, parasite and SARS responses, actin motility); bacterial attachment and entry separate it from the anti-inflammatory and Mtb confusables, and toxin uptake from antimicrobial-defense C2.

core: Base excision repair initiation by DNA glycosylases
qualifier: glycosylase defects and handoff to APEX1
name: DNA glycosylase damaged-base recognition, cleavage and handoff to APEX1
rationale: All members concern glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases (NTHL1, NEIL1/3) and their defects; NTHL1 defects and glycosylase displacement by APEX1 distinguish it from the alkylation-reversal and gap-filling confusables.

name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Most members describe erythroid commitment and terminal red cell maturation (one stress/TAK1 transcription module is peripheral); erythroid terminal maturation distinguishes it from megakaryocyte confusables C1/C4 and stem-cell confusables C2/C3.
